name: 01-never-dim
source: Make My Own Light, "Burn the Grief"
title: Make Your Own Light
caption:

name: 03-attention-for-care

caption:

name: 09-load-bearing
title: Load-Bearing Love
caption:

source: Make My Own Light, "Bliss Is Ignorance"

caption:

name: 15-i-survived
source: Make My Own Light, "To Be Continued"
title: To Be Continued
caption:
the last poem in the book. everyone expected me to be crying in the dark. i decided my story wasn't finished instead. if you're in a chapter that feels like an ending, it's a comma. ♡ - MK

if this one found you in the dark, stay. in the US you can call or text 988, any hour, and a real person will answer.
